For mobile (Android & iOS) ✅

No key ✅
Free ✅
With a movable GUI across the screen (Android & iOS & Windows & Linux & macOS) ✅

❤ A simple, free script with no key, that allows you to teleport anywhere by just activating the teleport function with a button and clicking where you want to go. ❤

📍 It works for absolutely any game that lets you walk freely. 📍

✅ (It lets you go to places blocked by the game, such as areas that require certain conditions, high or distant places!) ✅

🚨As a practically universal script, I will use a description I personally created in one of my old scripts. ❌ It's not spam, ✅ it's just saving time from writing all the games this script supports.🚨
